# India Code test fixtures

These files are small samples of responses from the public REST API of
[India Code](https://indiacode.gov.in), the Government of India's repository of
legislation. They were captured on 2026-10-03, while harvester's `india-code`
source was being built and demonstrated, so the tests can run without network
access.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `search_page.json` | One page of the central Acts listing (3 Acts). Long text fields are truncated. |
| `bundles_bns.json` | The file list for The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. |
| `bns_text_head.txt` | The first 6 KB of India Code's text extraction of the BNS. |

The content is Government of India legislation, reproduced here for testing
under section 52(1)(q) of the Indian Copyright Act, 1957.

Source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice,
Government of India. harvester is not affiliated with or endorsed by India Code.
